versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g Each SwCluC_LdComProxy_LdCom- CbkTriggerTransmit notification callback, where the parameter LdComUserCall- backType (See [ECUC_LdCom_00025]) is set to LDCOM_TX_TRIGGER_TRANSMIT , shall be configured as SwCluC_LdComProxy_<BS>_LdComCbkTriggerTransmit , where <BS> is the shortName of the SwCluCLdComProxyBaseSocket container.
